transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started on tomorrow's receiving plan. We've got two inbound lots — generator housings and communications cable reels — and three staging lanes available. Before I publish final lane assignments, I need to hear from each of you on anything that might affect how we assign those lanes. Warehouse ops, movement control — any changes or constraints I should know about?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint on the lane assignments. This morning I confirmed that only Lane 2 has a current floor-load certification for the 1,800-kilogram generator-housing pallet. The certification is filed in the warehouse binder, but it hasn't been added to the yard diagram yet, which is why the draft plan still shows all three lanes as interchangeable. The generator-housing pallet needs to go to Lane 2.
